# ChaCha20 CipherForge

> Interactive ARX Cryptographic Engine and RFC 8439 Stream Cipher Visualizer

ChaCha20 CipherForge is an educational cryptographic workbench implementing the RFC 8439 ChaCha20 stream cipher, Poly1305 MAC, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD construction.

## Features
- Pure 512-bit state matrix visualization (4x4 32-bit words)
- Step-by-step Quarter Round (ARX) execution: Addition, Rotation, and XOR
- Column rounds and diagonal rounds (20 rounds total)
- Live verification against authoritative RFC 8439 test vectors (§2.1.1, §2.3.2, §2.4.2)
- Real-time keystream block generation and XOR encryption/decryption stream
